messages.content: It tells transformers to import and execute Python shipped inside the model repository, rather than only using architectures built into the library. For DeepSeek-V3 style models it is required, because the modelling code lives in the repo. It also means you are running code from that repo with your own privileges, so pin the revision and read the files before enabling it on anything you did not publish yourself.
Explain why a scanner that produces false positives is worse than no scanner. (case 24)

A scanner exists to change a decision. If it flags healthy code, maintainers learn to ignore it, and the one true finding is ignored with the rest. No scanner leaves the decision where it was; a noisy one actively degrades it, because it spends the maintainer's trust and returns nothing.
